name: Portal Bridge
description: Portal Bridge is the token bridge interface for the Wormhole cross-chain messaging protocol, moving assets between Ethereum and other EVM chains, Solana, Sui, Aptos and more, secured by Wormhole's guardian network.
description_zh: Portal Bridge 是 Wormhole 跨链消息协议的代币桥界面，在以太坊和其他 EVM 链、Solana、Sui、Aptos 等之间转移资产，由 Wormhole 守护者网络保障安全。
chains: EVM, Solana, Sui, Aptos and more (Wormhole)

geo_feature.scope: Fusion swaps (market and limit orders): the quote API can refuse the selected tokens with GEO_BLOCKED ('Trading the selected tokens is not available in your region'); which tokens and countries is not published.

screening.provider: portalbridge.com checks both wallets of a transfer (checkWalletSanctions) before it starts; the archived UI used TRM Labs (risk score >= 10 -> block, fail-open), the wormhole-connect widget a hardcoded OFAC SDN list

evidence: portalbridge.com bundle: checkWalletSanctions for both wallets; GEO_BLOCKED quote error
